title: MED+250 controlled physical-device UAT approval
summary: Owner-ready QA approval for all 12 production-device scenarios, redacted evidence, safe test identities and confirmation that no unintended pharmacy was contacted. The UAT ledger and paired test record remain pending.

checks.name: Strict UAT ledger passes
checks.detail: The governed 12-scenario ledger remains pending and the strict UAT verifier cannot pass until every scenario has evidence and named execution and approval.

checks.name: Completed paired test record
checks.detail: The paired physical-device test artifact remains pending and therefore cannot yet support accountable QA approval.

checks.name: Approved opaque test identities
checks.detail: The QA owner must confirm the customer, pharmacy and unrelated-pharmacy labels refer only to pre-authorised controlled test identities.

checks.name: No unintended pharmacy contacted
checks.detail: The QA owner must explicitly confirm that no real request, OTP, prescription or message reached a pharmacy outside the approved test scope.

checks.name: All lifecycle and privacy boundaries accepted
checks.detail: The final approval must cover location, dispatch, OTP, offer, substitute, selection, handoff, cancellation, expiry, prescription and privacy-safe logging behavior.

checks.name: Residual test data removed
checks.detail: The QA owner must confirm disposable Auth sessions, identities, requests, notifications, prescriptions and any other controlled test data were removed or expired as designed.

checks.name: Named QA-owner signature
checks.detail: The accountable QA owner has not yet recorded the final decision, conditions, named approver, role and timezone-qualified approval timestamp.

completion_instructions: Complete the governed UAT ledger and paired test artifact and make npm run uat:verify:live pass.
Review every redacted scenario result and confirm the approved identity scope, no unintended contact, lifecycle behavior, privacy boundaries and cleanup.
Update the ledger and test digests if either file changed.
Set every check to passed, set decision to approved, add the named approver, role and timezone-qualified timestamp, and set status to complete.
Validate the completed approval strictly and add it to the launch registry only with its exact SHA-256 digest.
